label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest02136') flows through param to bar via doSomething(). The ternary guard (7*42)-num>200 evaluates to false (188>200=false), so bar=param (the taint propagates). Then bar is written directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding. This is a confirmed XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: Ternary guard (7*42)-num>200 is always false (188>200), so bar receives user input from param
